entries.dc41ab66fd0800cc: This is a single-segment business. Built on its flagship product “Yappli,” it provides solutions such as “Yappli for Marketing,” which supports official corporate apps; “UNITE by Yappli,” which supports internal apps for employees; and “Yappli for Business,” which supports portal apps for business partners. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥6,056 million, and the share of contracts by number at the end of the fiscal year ended December 2025 was 62% for Yappli for Marketing, 15% for UNITE by Yappli and 7% for Yappli for Business.
